name: Black Bean Enchiladas
desc: Poblano and black bean enchiladas under green salsa and melted cheese
steps: Preheat oven to 475°F with a rack in the top position. Dice poblano and tomato. Slice scallions, separating whites from greens. Drain beans over a small bowl, reserving the liquid. Mince the chili. Set aside 1/2 tsp of the Southwest spice for the crema.

Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high. Cook poblano until just softened, 3-4 minutes. Add tomato, scallion whites, half the beans, 2 tbsp bean liquid, and the remaining Southwest spice. Cook 2-3 minutes; season with salt and pepper.
Heat a drizzle of oil in a small pot. Add the remaining beans and cook 2-3 minutes, then add 3 tbsp bean liquid and simmer 1-2 minutes. Mash until mostly smooth and season with salt and pepper.

Spread tortillas with mashed beans, add filling to one half of each, and roll up. Place seam side down in a baking dish. Spoon the green salsa over and sprinkle with cheese. Bake on the top rack until bubbly, 3-5 minutes.
Stir the reserved spice into the sour cream, adding warm water 1 tsp at a time until drizzly. Top the enchiladas with crema, scallion greens, chili, and a squeeze of lime.
